title: A Principle-based Framework for the Development and Evaluation of Large Language Models for Health and Wellness
reasoning: The paper focuses on evaluating Large Language Models in the context of personal health and wellness using the SHARP framework (Safety, Helpfulness, Accuracy, Relevance, Personalization). While it includes evaluation subcomponents like 'Fairness' and 'ethical' treatment of users, it does not evaluate or benchmark religion, faith, theology, or specific moral/ethical systems.
